name: focus
role: someone who has just started dun in their project
goal: I want to read the conversation while I type, and know which pane my keys go to.
note: Focus walk (2026-10-24): the divider leaning toward the focused pane, and the selection band in the conversation.

steps.promise: When I start, it is clear my keys go to the input.
Tab moves my keys to the conversation, and the screen shows it without anything moving.
The selected message is easy to find and still easy to read.
Tab gives the input the keys back.
